name: Le Méridien Phuket Mai Khao Beach Resort
short_description: A newer, mid-century-modern-styled Le Méridien resort on Mai Khao Beach, about 13 km from the airport, with a private beach and family kids' club.
ai_summary: Le Méridien Phuket Mai Khao Beach Resort is a newer addition to Phuket's Mai Khao Beach cluster, blending mid-century modern design with local craftsmanship across 14 room and suite types. It's rated 4 of 5 across roughly 860 TripAdvisor reviews and ranks well within Mai Khao's hotel set, with guests praising a private beach described as feeling like an uninhabited island, lovely and attentive family-friendly staff, a well-zoned beachfront pool, and a dedicated Family Kids' Club with daily programming. Junior suites draw specific praise for space and comfort. As a newer, more compact property (14 room types versus the larger inventories at JW Marriott or Renaissance next door), it's positioned as an intimate, design-forward alternative on the same beach. The main watchouts in guest feedback are inconsistency at the margins rather than fundamental problems: at least one review describes basic service with limited attentiveness on room orders and towels, and another flagged buffet food quality as below expectations -- worth weighing against the otherwise strong staff and setting reviews. At roughly 13 km from the airport, it's one of the more convenient Mai Khao-area resorts for arrivals and departures.

pros: Rated 4 of 5 across roughly 860 TripAdvisor reviews, ranking well among Mai Khao-area hotels
Private beach described by guests as feeling secluded and uninhabited
Family Kids' Club and a well-zoned beachfront pool support longer family stays
Junior suites specifically praised as luxurious and spacious
About 13 km from Phuket International Airport, convenient for arrivals and departures
cons: A newer, more design-boutique property with fewer restaurants than the larger neighboring Mai Khao resorts
At least one review describes basic service with limited proactive attentiveness (room orders, towels)
One guest reported the complimentary buffet food quality was below expectations
research_highlights: Staff are described as lovely, family-friendly, and super attentive, with at least one account of staff going above and beyond to secure a better room
The private beach is repeatedly described as quiet, clean, and giving a feeling of staying on an uninhabited island
Junior suite rooms are called out as luxurious and spacious
research_watchouts: At least one review describes disappointingly basic service with limited proactive check-ins on orders or towels
A guest reported the complimentary buffet food quality was poor -- worth confirming current dining standards before relying heavily on included breakfast

faqs.question: How far is Le Méridien Phuket Mai Khao Beach Resort from the airport?
faqs.answer: It's about 13 km from Phuket International Airport, roughly a 15-minute drive, making it one of the more convenient Mai Khao Beach resorts for arrivals and departures.

faqs.question: Is Le Méridien Phuket Mai Khao Beach Resort good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has a dedicated Family Kids' Club, family rooms with bunk beds, and a beachfront pool with kid-friendly zones, and guest reviews specifically praise the staff as attentive with families.
